g.data-variants: BC 3FE53701BC (R4.3.01 only, superseded by BD), BD 3FE53701BD, BF 3FE53701BF - one face. All three are drawn by the same Nokia drawing 22447 (3FE53701BCAATQZZA01 p8 Figure 3, 3FE53701BDAATQZZA06 p11 Figure 3, Lightspan UDS 3HH90279AAAATQZZA23 p163 Figure 67 and p175 Figure 71, the last two one embedded image object). The BD and BF list the same interfaces; the BF differs in its compliance statements
